_comment: Tiny-chat MoR block housekeeping (LOCAL_LLM_STACK.md section 11 item 1.2): the three MoR3 r1 rungs (steps 500, 1000, 2500) that failed when mtstudio score ran out of GPU memory beside the trainer (the vendored-GEMM buffer cache, fixed in 86a978ca), rescored from their home snapshots at the MoR campaign's pin. This file is the only change on top of 86a978ca (branch rescore-mor3-r1). data is the MoR campaign's own data job, argv for argv (it rebuilds the panels the rung jobs read; its ledger is compared with C:/ml_artifacts/tiny_chat/e1_mor/data/data.ledger.json). stage puts the uploaded snapshots (C:/ml_artifacts/tiny_chat/e1_mor/pt_e1_mor_MoR3_r1/rung_snapshots/rung_N/, state.txt N) and the run's home events.jsonl at the VM paths the rung jobs read; the three rung jobs are the campaign's rung_e1_mor_MoR3_r1_s{500,1000,2500} argv for argv. Uploads: --upload vocab_llama3_bpe.gguf=/mnt/c/ml_artifacts/capacity/vocab/vocab_llama3_bpe.gguf --upload mor3_r1_rung_500.safetensors=... (see the driver entry). One RunPod L4, about 1.5 h.

jobs.name: stage
cmd: set -euo pipefail; P=/content/chat/pt_e1_mor_MoR3_r1; U=/content/chat/upload; mkdir -p $P; cp $U/mor3_r1_events.jsonl $P/events.jsonl; for s in 500 1000 2500; do mkdir -p $P/rung_$s; cp $U/mor3_r1_rung_$s.safetensors $P/rung_$s/model.safetensors; cp $U/mor3_r1_rung_${s}_state.txt $P/rung_$s/state.txt; done; sha256sum $P/events.jsonl $P/rung_*/model.safetensors > {out}/staged.sha256; head -c 4 $P/rung_*/state.txt >> {out}/staged.sha256
